messages:
sam: Heads-up: postmortem follow-ups for inference throttling incident. Need a short customer-facing summary and to confirm RCA-sharing policy for enterprise customers.
rachel: I'll draft the customer summary. Pete, can SRE confirm duration windows?
peter: SRE confirms impact window 2026-01-12 10:0010:45 UTC. Will add timeline notes.
ops-bot: Action created ACTION-3010 assigned to sam: assign owners for follow-ups.
legal: For enterprise RCA access, we require NDA or support request channel with legal cc. We can provide a redacted RCA and offer a scheduled 1:1 deep dive.
sam: Okay that works. Propose owners: customer summary (rachel) due +48h, enterprise RCA outreach (sam + legal) due +72h, verification of mitigation (peter) due +7d.
rachel: Draft statuspage snippet: 
```
We observed elevated throttling affecting some inference requests between 10:0010:45 UTC. The immediate mitigation reduced throttling and normal service has resumed. We are investigating root cause and will provide updates.
```
peter: Suggest small wording change: use "rate limiting" instead of "throttling" for clarity to customers. Internal RCA can keep the latter.
legal: Also avoid mentioning vendor names in public copy unless they've agreed.
sam: I'll add a recurring-incident tag. Note: this is the second throttling-like incident in the last month. We'll include a short internal note on patterns.
rachel: Adding actions to tracker: 
- ACTION-3011: Draft public statuscopy (rachel) +24h
- ACTION-3012: Prepare enterprise outreach template (sam + legal) +72h
- ACTION-3013: Mitigation verification (peter) +7d
- ACTION-3014: Tag & recurring-incident memo (sam) +2d
ops-bot: ACTION-3011 status: New.
peter: Once the public copy is ready, I'll confirm timestamps so statuspage is accurate.
sam: thanks team. Please update ACTION items as you progress.
